metodo_fixado: CPU, JSON only, no npz. (0) Check first: reproduce the 4 published R and the 8 SDs of Table 8 from the sources (tolerance 0.005) and the F intervals of theta in the Table 8 legend ([3.0; 131.8] GNN Bauru Q1; [8.1; 87.3] GNN and [1.5; 18.8] MLP Campinas Q1; tolerance 0.05); a discrepancy aborts (rc 3). (a) PRIMARY READING: one-factor ANOVA (random factor: draw) with 3 nested seeds, on the crossed matrix; theta_hat = (MS_draw - MS_seed)/(3 MS_seed); 95% CI of theta by F with df (n-1; 2n), n = 5 or 10; R = sqrt(1+theta) and its CI by monotone transformation (R >= 1 by construction). (b) SECOND READING: R_20 = SD(20 draws, s42, ddof=1)/sqrt(MS_seed), F interval with df (19; 2n) treating numerator and denominator as independent, declaring the overlap of the s42 column. (c) SENSITIVITY: leave-one-draw-out of theta_hat and of R in the crossed block (record the draw that moves most; ss723969 expected in Campinas Q1 GNN). (d) RECORD: joint nonparametric bootstrap by draw id (B = 4000, seed 20261027, numpy default_rng): in each replicate the ids used at seed 42 are resampled with replacement; SD across draws over the sampled ids; pooled SD = sqrt(MS_seed) over the crossed rows whose ids were drawn, with multiplicity; a replicate with < 2 crossed rows is discarded and counted; BCa and percentile CI, bootstrap mean alongside. (e) For the 8 SDs across draws of Table 8: chi-square CI under normality (df n-1) and BCa CI by bootstrap over draws; the ratio to 0.132 dB is reported as CI_SD/0.132, stating that 0.132 is the maximum of two repetitions, not an estimator with a variance. The MS_seed formula is reused from v3_G1_agregar_v10.py::decomposicao_um_fator by ast extraction with the sha checked.
previsao: theta_hat with lower limit > 1 in both GNN pairs (the published F intervals already exclude 1: 3.0 and 8.1) and in the Campinas Q1 MLP (1.5); Bauru Q1 MLP with CI including 1 (current text: 'includes unity'). R between 2 and 11; second reading wider; bootstrap by id unstable in Bauru Q1 (5 ids).
leitura: Lower limit of the 95% CI of theta > 1 (R > sqrt 2) in >= 3 of the 4 pairs -> REINFORCES S8: the text says the draw dominates the seed in the named pairs, with the CIs of R, and 'point estimate only' for the remaining pair. CI of theta excludes 0 but not 1 in >= 2 pairs -> DELIMITS: 'draw effect present, of the order of the seed effect'. CI of theta includes 0 in some pair -> the text drops the ratio of that pair. The phrase 'X times the pooled SD' of the abstract and of the legend carries the CI of R of reading (a) alongside; 'lower limit > 1' is NOT a success criterion (R >= 1 by construction).
se_inverter: No outcome reverses S4 or the drift in magnitude of S8 (SD across draws of the order of the mean, Table 8, does not depend on R). The worst outcome removes the draw x seed comparison as an abstract number.
